title: Cardano k-value adjustment proposal behind the decentralized debate
description: Recently, a highly symbolic on-chain debate has begun within the Cardano ecosystem. A proposal vote to increase the parameter stakePoolTargetNum (i.e., k-value) from 500 to 1000 has been officially launched. This adjustment directly impacts the core economic model that sustains the distribution of staked stakes across the entire network. What does this proposal mean for a layperson and holder without technical background? In the Cardano Ouroboros proof-of-stake algorithm, k-value represents the system's 'ideal number of stake pools' it aims for. In Cardano's system, which distributes a relatively fixed total staking reward pool at each epoch, the protocol seeks to prevent the concentration of computational resources and stakes.

Join Romain Soulat and Jean-Frédéric Etienne from IOG to see how Blaster can automatically prove that a contract meets its specification - or produce a concrete counterexample when it doesn’t. We’ll explore: • Lean 4 & automated proofs • UPLC, CEK & ledger formalization
